description: This file contains code related to CPU feature detection and initialization for ARM64 architecture in Go, including reading system registers and setting feature flags.

methods.name: initOptions
methods.description: Initializes CPU feature options based on predefined list.

methods.name: archInit
methods.description: Initializes architecture-specific CPU features based on OS.

methods.name: setMinimalFeatures
methods.description: Sets minimal CPU features for testing purposes.

methods.name: readARM64Registers
methods.description: Reads ARM64 system registers to detect CPU features.

methods.name: parseARM64SystemRegisters
methods.description: Parses system register values to set feature flags.

methods.name: parseARM64SVERegister
methods.description: Parses SVE register to detect SVE2 support.

methods.name: extractBits
methods.description: Extracts specific bits from a uint64 value.
